تقتطفون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِفُونَ (taqtaṭifūna) /taq.ta.tˤi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# تُقْتَطَفُونَ (tuqtaṭafūna) /tuq.ta.tˤa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
